name: hit-rate
description: Gives each finding of done-gate, assertion-guard, self-audit and zukan a later verdict from what the session did next, keeps each rule's precision across sessions, and names the rules loopback should stop feeding; off by default

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Score the detectors' findings by what happened next; off by default

minN.title: Minimum verdicts
minN.description: A rule is judged for muting only once it has this many true or false verdicts

threshold.title: Precision threshold
threshold.description: A rule whose precision is below this (0 to 1) is named for loopback to stop feeding
